NAV.NO_MATCH: No setting matches. Try another word.

WIDGET.WHAT: How your website chat looks, where visitors can continue the chat, and which pages start conversations.
WIDGET.NO_INBOX: Add a website inbox first (Settings → Inboxes → Website).
WIDGET.OLD_WIDGET: This workspace still uses the previous widget: the hand-off links and page stats start once the Tolzar widget is switched on.
WIDGET.TAGLINE: We usually reply within a few minutes.
WIDGET.SAMPLE_IN: Hi, do you deliver on Saturdays?
WIDGET.CONTRAST_large: White text contrast {ratio}:1: only for large text, pick a darker colour
WIDGET.CONTRAST_fail: White text contrast {ratio}:1: too light, pick a darker colour
WIDGET.HANDOFF_HINT: Visitors can open your WhatsApp, Instagram or Telegram from the chat. Owner only.

DASH.FIRST_REPLY: First reply, last 14 days (average per day)

BOOKINGS_CARD.TITLE: Bookings
BOOKINGS_CARD.FAILED: The booking system did not answer.
BOOKINGS_CARD.NONE: No bookings for this guest yet.

BOOKINGS.WHAT: Bookings with guests, dates and lines, a record of payments (Tolzar never charges a card), and a voucher from any booking.
BOOKINGS.OFF: Bookings are not switched on for this workspace yet.
BOOKINGS.BALANCES: Balances still due in the next 14 days: {amount}
BOOKINGS.EMPTY_AGENDA: No bookings in the next 14 days.

DOCS.WHAT: Vouchers, quotes, booking confirmations and payment summaries. Totals come from the lines, a placeholder (TBC) blocks issuing, and every issued document gets the next number. Nothing is sent to the customer from here.
DOCS.OFF: Documents are not switched on for this workspace yet.
DOCS.NO_ID: Never enter ID or passport numbers: documents refuse them.
DOCS.PLACEHOLDER_HINT: A price still says TBC: the draft saves, but it cannot be issued until it is filled in.
DOCS.PREFIXES_HINT: 2 to 8 capital letters or digits per type, e.g. VCH-26-0001. Owner only.

LEAD_SOURCES.WHAT: Leads from lead forms and ad clicks, per source and campaign, with how many reached your won and lost stages.
LEAD_SOURCES.EMPTY: No leads with a source in this period yet.
LEAD_SOURCES.FAILED: Could not load the lead sources. Try again.
LEAD_SOURCES.SPEND_LATER: Ad spend and cost per lead appear here once your ad accounts' reports are connected.

LEAD_INTAKE.OFF: Lead forms are not switched on for this workspace yet. Ask Tolzar support to turn them on.
LEAD_INTAKE.NO_INBOX: Add an API inbox first (Settings → Inboxes → API). Each API inbox gets its own lead link.
LEAD_INTAKE.SECRET: This link works like a password: anyone with it can add leads. Paste it only into your form tool.
LEAD_INTAKE.FIELDS_TITLE: What to send (JSON or form fields)
LEAD_INTAKE.FIELDS: name, email, phone (with the + country code), source (for example tiktok), lead_id, campaign, ad, form, and answers as question and answer pairs.
LEAD_INTAKE.RESULT: Each lead becomes a contact on your first pipeline stage and a conversation with the answers, labelled lead.

SHADOW_DETAIL.sla: Late conversations get a label and a private note. Customers see nothing.
SHADOW_DETAIL.recovery: Follow-ups are drafted as private notes. Nothing is sent to the lead.
SHADOW_DETAIL.broadcasts: Preview and runs show exactly who would receive it. Nothing is sent.
SHADOW_DETAIL.sms: Tolzar shows the exact SMS it would send through your provider. No SMS leaves.
SHADOW_DETAIL.crm: Every run lists what would change in your CRM. Nothing is written there.
SHADOW_DETAIL.commerce: Tolzar reads your catalogue and order status only. Nothing is changed in the shop.
SHADOW_DETAIL.order_chat: Order status is read for this channel and answered in Shadow: the AI drafts, nothing is sent.
SHADOW_DETAIL.documents: The text is read for triage only and never stored.
SHADOW_DETAIL.tuning: Proposals only: nothing in the agent changes until you copy an approved edit yourself.
SHADOW_DETAIL.meta_app: Pages connect listen-only: Tolzar receives, your team keeps answering in Meta Business Suite.
SHADOW_DETAIL.whatsapp_listen: Tolzar only receives this number's messages. It never sends on it.
SHADOW_DETAIL.lead_intake: Leads only arrive here. Nothing is sent to the person: your team or the AI (in Shadow) follows up.

EXPORT.PREPARING: Preparing your export. It will appear in the list below when it is ready.
EXPORT.READY: Your export is ready to download.
EXPORT.TIMED_OUT: Still preparing after 10 minutes. Come back later and reload this section.
EXPORT.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Could not download this file. The link may have expired (7 days): prepare a new export.

MEDIA.FIELD_DESC: What to read from the photo
MEDIA.FIELD_DESC_PLACEHOLDER: What to read from the photo

BROADCASTS.VALUE_PLACEHOLDER: The value the field must have
BROADCASTS.SHADOW_RUN: Shadow run: {n} contacts would have received it. Nothing was sent.
BROADCASTS.LAST_RUN: last Shadow run: {n} would have received it

MCP.CREATED: Token created. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
MCP.SHOWN_ONCE: Shown once. Copy it now; Tolzar does not store it in a readable form.

PIPELINE.DELETE_BODY: Contacts in this stage are not moved: they keep a stage that is no longer in your list and show as an unknown stage until someone moves them. Remove it only once they are moved.
